title: Multi-model prediction and comparative study of protein folding rates based on LASSO feature selection.
authors: Chen, Guanhong; Xiao, Liping; Yu, Mingzhou; Bai, Gongxun; Jiang, Zhouting
one_liner_zh: 该文用LASSO特征选择结合多种机器学习模型预测蛋白质折叠速率，虽以蛋白质结构参数为输入，但核心是速率预测而非结构计算建模，方法上无AI/物理模拟创新，属于工程化应用，故评6分。
abstract: Accurate prediction of protein folding rates is essential for understanding protein dynamics. However, existing structural parameters show limited generalizability across two-state and multi-state proteins and are affected by multicollinearity. Here, LASSO regression was applied to a training set of 145 proteins to identify six structural features (L(eff), LRO, ACO, Sheet, H(nc), and P(beta)) from 12 structural parameters. These features were used to construct four machine learning models (RR, RF, SVM, and SSA-BP). Model performance was evaluated on an independent test set of 29 proteins, with bootstrap resampling used to assess performance uncertainty. On the full test set, RF achieved the lowest RMSE and MAE, whereas SSA-BP showed the highest correlation coefficient (R =0.9282). Folding-type-specific analysis revealed distinct model performance patterns between two-state and multi-state proteins. SHAP analysis further showed that the relative contributions of structural features varied across models and folding types, with L(eff), LRO, and ACO making substantial contributions. Overall, the proposed framework integrates feature selection, predictive modeling, and model interpretation, providing an interpretable approach for protein folding rate prediction.
abstract_zh: 准确预测蛋白质折叠速率对于理解蛋白质动力学至关重要。然而，现有结构参数在二态和多态蛋白质中的泛化能力有限，并受多重共线性影响。本研究将LASSO回归应用于包含145个蛋白质的训练集，从12个结构参数中筛选出六个结构特征（L(eff)、LRO、ACO、Sheet、H(nc)和P(beta)）。利用这些特征构建了四种机器学习模型（RR、RF、SVM和SSA-BP）。模型性能在包含29个蛋白质的独立测试集上进行了评估，并使用bootstrap重采样来评估性能不确定性。在完整测试集上，RF取得了最低的RMSE和MAE，而SSA-BP显示出最高的相关系数（R =0.9282）。折叠类型特异性分析揭示了二态和多态蛋白质之间不同的模型性能模式。SHAP分析进一步表明，结构特征的相对贡献在不同模型和折叠类型间存在差异，其中L(eff)、LRO和ACO贡献显著。总体而言，所提出的框架整合了特征选择、预测建模和模型解释，为蛋白质折叠速率预测提供了一种可解释的方法。
